storyboardBeats.narration: A humming that changes when you steer is not your tires.

storyboardBeats.narration: Wheel bearing noise gets louder turning one way, quieter the other. You are loading the bad side.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Overhead top-down shot of a car's front wheels turning left then right on a shop alignment rack, slow arc pan following the steering motion, even overhead light, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Tire noise does not do that. It stays the same through the turn.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a tire tread rolling slowly across pavement texture, steady lateral dolly, neutral daylight, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Ignore it, and a bearing does not get better. It can seize, and the wheel can lock up.
